body.label: Effect
body.html: On success, deal 1 Necrotic Damage and suppress 1 point of its ordinary accuracy bonuses until the start of your next turn.

surges.html: On a hit, its next forced movement is increased by 1 unit until the start of your next turn.
On a hit, it is Distracted until the start of your next turn.

rider.title: Rite - Hex
rider.html: Rite, 2 Echoes: on a hit, the target becomes Possessed. Trigger: it misses an Action. Echo: impose -1 Composure against the next attack before your next turn.
